title: Microsoft Forms: Copilot Chat pane and Surveys Agent for form authors
summary: The briefing passes: its feature description, licensing, rollout facts and documented controls are supported. The corrected prerequisites match Microsoft's general requirements, and the remaining documentation gaps are narrowly stated rather than presented as unavailable capabilities.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn has no dedicated admin page for the Forms pane or Surveys Agent at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Surveys Agent'; 'Surveys Agent Microsoft Forms administrator documentation'. Read Forms administrator settings, setup, Copilot settings and agent management; results supplied no dedicated administration page for this Forms integration.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; Why it matters
claims.claim: The capability is user-opt-in: licensed users choose to open it from the Forms authoring experience.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft Forms Copilot chat pane Surveys Agent disable tenant admin switch Graph PowerShell. Read Forms and Copilot settings; no pane-specific switch found. Record: 'can be accessed by clicking the "Copilot" icon in Forms.'

claims.claim: Neither the roadmap nor release notes says this integration changes anything for users who do not click its icon.
claims.quote: Searched: Forms, Copilot icon, 553136 in the roadmap record and release notes. Read the full Forms entry, including its Details and Try this steps; neither describes an automatic action for users who do not open the pane.

claims.claim: Administrators can assign or remove the licence per user through the Microsoft 365 admin center or Graph PowerShell.
claims.quote: you can also use the Microsoft Graph PowerShell SDK to assign Microsoft 365 licenses to user accounts with PowerShell or remove Microsoft 365 licenses from user accounts with PowerShell.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Cost and licensing; Governance controls
claims.claim: Assigning licences requires at least License Administrator or User Administrator.
claims.quote: You must be at least a License or User Administrator to assign licenses.

claims.claim: Licence assignment is at Microsoft 365 admin center > Users > Active users > user > Licenses and Apps > Licenses.
claims.quote:
go to the Users > Active users page.
Select the row of the user that you want to assign a license to.
In the right pane, select Licenses and Apps.
Expand the Licenses section, select the boxes for the licenses that you want to assign

claims.claim: Set-MgUserLicense -UserId $userUPN -AddLicenses @{SkuId = "<SkuId>"} -RemoveLicenses @() assigns a selected licence to a user.
claims.quote:
To assign a license to a user, use the following command in PowerShell.
Set-MgUserLicense -UserId $userUPN -AddLicenses @{SkuId = "<SkuId>"} -RemoveLicenses @()

claims.claim: Forms access is controlled at Microsoft 365 admin center > Users > Active users > user > Manage product licenses > Licenses and Apps > Apps > Microsoft Forms.
claims.quote:
choose Users > Active users.
Select the box next to the name of the person
On the ribbon, click Manage product licenses.
On the account form that opens, on the Licenses and Apps tab, expand the Apps section and scroll down to the Microsoft Forms option.

claims.claim: Set-MgUserLicense -UserId $userUPN -AddLicenses $addLicenses -RemoveLicenses @() can disable Forms when $addLicenses specifies its disabled service plan.
claims.quote: This example updates a user with SPE_E5 (Microsoft 365 E5) and turns off the Sway and Forms service plans while leaving the user's existing disabled plans in their current state:

claims.claim: The PowerShell example sets DisabledPlans using FORMS_PLAN_E5 for the E5 Forms service plan.
Turning Forms off for a user removes access to Forms altogether, rather than only Copilot.
claims.quote: When you turn off Microsoft Forms for a user, that person can't use Microsoft Forms. The Forms tile will be hidden in the Microsoft 365 app launcher and homepage.

claims.claim: A tenant-wide switch specific to the Copilot pane in Forms is not documented on the named UI or API surfaces.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft Forms Copilot chat pane Surveys Agent disable tenant admin switch Graph PowerShell; Forms Copilot disable pane. Read Forms settings, Copilot settings and agent management. Graph side-pane search covered unlicensed users, not this licensed Forms pane.

claims.claim: The Forms administrator-settings page lists no Copilot or Surveys Agent setting.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot and Surveys Agent in the fully read Forms administrator-settings page. Its sections cover External sharing, Record names of people in your org, Phishing protection, Allow YouTube and Bing, and user license assignment, not a Copilot control.
